login: Add EmitArcBooted D-Bus method to allow Chrome to send arc-booted Upstart signal. Currently, the signal is sent by /etc/init/arc-boot-watcher.conf like this: script [...] while ! /usr/sbin/android-sh -c 'getprop sys.boot_completed' | grep 1 ; do sleep 1 done initctl emit arc-booted end script but as you can see, it's based on a polling and is not very clean. With this CL, we can remove the Upstart hack. BUG=b:31254747 TEST=cros_run_unit_tests --board=cyan --packages chromeos-login TEST=cros_run_unit_tests --board=rambi --packages chromeos-login TEST='grep arc-booted /var/log/messages' on a device CQ-DEPEND=CL:384616 Change-Id: I655acbf8783f16d768cc24e36a7a9e68f1b69b41 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/384594 Commit-Ready: Yusuke Sato <yusukes@chromium.org> Tested-by: Yusuke Sato <yusukes@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Dan Erat <derat@chromium.org>

metrics: use global maximum for memory histograms Previously, MeminfoMem[Used|Free]Derived was being reported with the maximum value set to the total system memory. laptop-mode-tools: Add support for hmp CPU Currently laptop-mode-tools assumes the existence of the sysfs interface /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/interactive. But in systems with both little and big cores, the sysfs interface is now sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/policy[0-9]+/interactive, One for little and one for big. Patching laptop-mode-tools to support the same. BUG=chrome-os-partner:57347 TEST=cros-deploy <ip> laptop-mode-tools Change-Id: If6b6f2efa87f634e0880d084764bb4d5a7546ade Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/384314 Commit-Ready: Ravi Chandra Sadineni <ravisadineni@chromium.org> Tested-by: Ravi Chandra Sadineni <ravisadineni@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Derek Basehore <dbasehore@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Mike Frysinger <vapier@chromium.org>
